headers.//: No unsafe-eval anywhere. style-src needs unsafe-inline because the marquee keyframes and the reveal delays are set as inline styles; script-src does not, so an injected script has nowhere to run.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests

headers.//: The page needs none of these, so every one is denied rather than left to the browser default.
headers.value: accelerometer=(), autoplay=(self), camera=(), display-capture=(), encrypted-media=(), fullscreen=(self), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), midi=(), payment=(), publickey-credentials-get=(), screen-wake-lock=(), usb=(), xr-spatial-tracking=()

headers.//: Hashed build assets are immutable, so they are cached for a year.
Films are large and stable, but their names are not hashed, so they revalidate daily rather than being pinned for a year.
